full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 44
Daily Business Schedule
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Monday, Bhadra 1, 2083
1:00 PM
Management Work
1. The Honorable Speaker will present the proposal to "Consider the Mines and Minerals Bill, 2083".
2. Honorable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita Kumari Poudel,
a) Will present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Child Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
b) Will introduce the "Child Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
3. Honorable Foreign Minister, Shishir Khanal, will present a proposal to "Consider the Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. Honorable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita Kumari Poudel, will present a proposal to "Consider the Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The session began with the Honorable Speaker presenting a proposal for consideration of the Mines and Minerals Bill, 2083. Subsequently, the Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security sought permission to introduce and then introduced the Child Related (First Amendment) Bill, 2083. The Foreign Minister then presented a proposal to consider the Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083.
